ambient_events: The compressor in the fridge shudders, catches, and settles into its hum.
Out in the shed, a trailer door goes over and somebody swears at it without any real feeling.
One of the cots creaks as whoever is on it turns over.
The strip light ticks, dims for a moment, and comes back.
A truck idles somewhere outside for a long while and then shuts down.
description: The room behind the office. Four cots with folded blankets, a television bracketed up in the corner, a humming fridge, and a steel sink under a strip of mirror. Red grit has drifted in under the door into a small dune along the skirting.
name: The Deadleg — the bunkroom
